dcterms:title: corrigiarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "corrigiarius" is someone who works as a belt maker.

dcterms:title: notarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "notarius" is someone who works as a notary.

dcterms:title: botarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "botarius" is someone who works as a cooper, a craftsman who makes and repairs barrels and similar wooden vessels such as casks, buckets and tubs.

dcterms:title: bancherius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "bancherius" refers to someone who works as a banker.

dcterms:title: lanerius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "lanerius" is someone who works as a wool merchant. This is generally an entrepreneurial figure who operates one or more wool shops and hires a variety of wool workers.

dcterms:title: marinarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "marinarius" is a maritime crew with duties related to the operation of the vessel.

dcterms:title: calzolarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "calzolarius" was someone who worked as a cobbler.

dcterms:title: macellarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "macellarius" is someone who works as a butcher.

dcterms:title: stagnarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "stagnarius" is somene who works as a tinsmith, generally an independent master artisan with a workshop.
cidoc-crm:P3_has_note: See Florence de Roover, Glossary, p. 279.

dcterms:title: peliparius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "peliparius" is someone who works as a pelter.
dcterms:alternative: pelliparius | pellissarius | pellizzaro | pellissaro | pelissaro | pellissano

dcterms:title: iuponerius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "iuponerius" is someone who works as a coat-maker, or more specifically, a doublet maker.

dcterms:title: mersarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "mersarius" is someone who works as a mercer or haberdasher.

dcterms:title: barberius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "barberius" is someone who works as a barber.

dcterms:title: canabacerius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "canabacerius" is someone who worked as a rope-maker.

dcterms:title: seatarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "seatarius" is someone who works as a silk merchant, usually with their own workshop.

dcterms:title: tabernarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "tabernarius" is someone who works as an inn-keeper.

dcterms:title: filator septe
dcterms:description: A person named as a "filator septe" is someone who works as a silk spinner.

dcterms:title: cultelerius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "cultelerius" is someone who works as a cutler.

dcterms:title: sartor
dcterms:description: A person named as a  "sartor" is someone who works as a tailor.

dcterms:title: abbas/abbatissa
dcterms:description: A person named as an "abbas" or an "abbatissaa" is someone who works as the abbot or abbess of a monastery, generally the monk or nun elected as the superior person of the monastery.

dcterms:title: gramatice professor
dcterms:description: A person named as a "gramatice professor" is someone who is a teacher of Latin grammar.

dcterms:title: coirasarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "coirasarius" is someone who works as an armorer or armor-maker.

dcterms:title: legum doctor
dcterms:description: A person named as a "legum doctor" is someone who works as a lawyer. The term "doctor in utroque" is also common.
dcterms:alternative: doctor in utroque | iuris utriusque doctoris | legum scholaris

dcterms:title: revenditor raubarum
dcterms:description: A person named as a "revenditor raubarum" is someone who resells clothing.

dcterms:title: calafatus
dcterms:description: A person named as a "calafatus" is someone who works as a caulker, usually in the shipbuilding industry.

dcterms:title: casanerius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "casanerius" is someone who works as a pawnbroker.

dcterms:title: battifolius
dcterms:description: A person named "battifolius" is someone who works as a metal beater, usuallly in gold or silver.

dcterms:title: callegarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "callegarius" is someone who works as a bootmaker.

dcterms:title: magister cammocatorum
dcterms:description: A person named as a "magister cammocatorum" is someone who works as a linen or silk merchant.

dcterms:title: faber
dcterms:description: A person named as a "faber" is someone who works as a blacksmith.

dcterms:title: speciarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "speciarius" is someone who works as an apothecary.

dcterms:title: tinctor septe
dcterms:description: A person named as a "tinctor septe" is someone who works as a silk-dyer.

dcterms:title: monaca
dcterms:description: A person named as a "monaca" is a woman who serves as a nun in a female monastery.

dcterms:title: confector
dcterms:description: A person named as a "confector" is someone who works as tanner.

dcterms:title: paterius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "paterius" is someone who works as a cloth merchant.
cidoc-crm:P3_has_note: See Rossi, Glossario medioevale ligure, p. 74.

dcterms:title: textor pannorum septe
dcterms:description: A "textor pannorum septe" is a person who works as a silk-weaver.
dcterms:alternative: textor pannorum siricorum | textor sericorum | tessitore di panni di seta

dcterms:title: doctor arte et medicine
dcterms:description: A person named as a "doctor arte et medicine" is someone who works as a physician, that is, a doctor of medicine.
dcterms:alternative: medicine doctor | doctor artium et medicine | phisicus | fixici | phixico

dcterms:title: bambaxarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "bambaxarius" is someone who works as a cotton weaver.

dcterms:title: draperius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "draperius" is a person who works as a draper.

dcterms:title: magister cintorum
dcterms:description: A person named as a "magister cintorum" is someone who works as a belt-maker. They are a specialized form of leather worker.

dcterms:title: copertorerius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "copertorerius" is someone who works as a rug maker or carpet maker, generally from woolen cloth.

dcterms:title: cappellanus
dcterms:description: A person named as a "cappellanus" is someone who is a chaplain for a household or institution.

dcterms:title: pancogolus
dcterms:description: A person named as a "pancogolus" is someone who works as a baker, specifically of bread.

dcterms:title: fornarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "fornarius" is someone who works as a baker.

dcterms:title: correrius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "correrius" is someone who works as a leather worker.

dcterms:title: formagarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "formagarius" is someone who works as a cheese-maker.
dcterms:alternative: formagliarius | formaiarus | formagiarius | formaglarius | formaiarius | formagerius

dcterms:title: commissarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "commissarius" is someone works as a commissioner. In the late medieval and early modern era this was usually someone named as head of a delegation.

dcterms:title: clericus
dcterms:description: A person named as a "clericus" is someone who works as a scribe or a clerk, often for a religious institution.

dcterms:title: nauta
dcterms:description: A person named as a "nauta" is someone who works as a sailor or seaman.

dcterms:title: iocalista
dcterms:description: A person named as a "iocalista" is someone who sells ornamental jewelry, as opposed to fine jewelry, and other sorts of trinkets.

dcterms:title: spadarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "spadarius" is someone who works as a sword-maker. Essentially, a specialized form of metal worker.

dcterms:title: tornator
dcterms:description: A person named as a "tornator" is someone who works as a potter.

dcterms:title: macarolius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "macarolius" is someone who works as a cloth weaver.

dcterms:title: quarelerius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "quarelerius" is a someone who works as a judiciary officer. They were responsible for law enforcement and implementing punishment, including corporal punishment.

dcterms:title: bancalarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "bancalarius" is a someone who works as a carpenter.

dcterms:title: magister tinctorum
dcterms:description: A person named as a "magister tinctorum" is somone who makes dyes (as opposed to a dyer, who dyes various forms of textiles).

dcterms:title: preceptor
dcterms:description: A person named as a "preceptor" is someone who works as a tutor or teacher.

dcterms:title: monachus
dcterms:description: A person named as a "monachus" is a man who works as a monk in a male monastery.

dcterms:title: prelatus
dcterms:description: A person named as a "prelatus" is someone who works as a prelate, generally a high-ranking member of the clergy.

dcterms:title: magister axie
dcterms:description: A person named as a "magister axie" is a someone who works as a shipwright. Essentially, it a specialized form of wood worker who works with planks.

dcterms:title: bancarotus
dcterms:description: A person named as a "bancarotus" is someone who works as a money-changer or a petty banker.

dcterms:title: barrillarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "barrillarius" is a person who works as a cooper or barrel maker.

dcterms:title: ortolanus
dcterms:description: A person named as an "ortolanus" is someone who works as a gardener or farmer, in particular someone who grows vegetables.

dcterms:title: censarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "censarius" is someone who works as a commercial agent or commercial representative.

dcterms:title: mansionarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "mansionarius" is someone who works as a canon of a church.

dcterms:title: pater
dcterms:description: A person named as a "pater" is someone who works as a preacher or a priest.

dcterms:title: pexarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "pexarius" is a fish merchant.

dcterms:title: miles
dcterms:description: A person named as a "miles" is someone who works as a soldier.

dcterms:title: accimator
dcterms:description: A person named as an "accimator" is someone who works as a shearer or cutter of textiles.

dcterms:title: balistarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "balistarius" is someone who works as an archer (generally with a cross-bow, in a military sense).

dcterms:title: unctor
dcterms:description: A person named as an "unctor" is someone who works as a dyer.

dcterms:title: canonicus
dcterms:description: A person named as a "canonicus" is someone who works as a canon for a religious institution.

dcterms:title: textor pannorum lane
dcterms:description: A person named as a "textor pannorum lane" is someone who works as a wool weaver.

dcterms:title: remolarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "remolarius" is somenone who works as an an oar-maker, a specialized form of wood worker.

dcterms:title: vetrerius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "vetrerius" is someone who works as a glass maker.

dcterms:title: episcopus
dcterms:description: A person named as an "episcopus" is someone who has been appointed ands works as a bishop.

dcterms:title: cordoanerius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "cordoanerius" is someone who works as a leatherworker, in particular in the manufacture of straps, cords, and bindings.

dcterms:title: cartarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "cartarius" is somone who works as a maker of paper or parchment.

dcterms:title: armerius
dcterms:description: A person who is named as an "armerius" is someone who works as a cabinetmaker.
cidoc-crm:P3_has_note: I'm not absolutely certain about the nature of this occupation.

dcterms:title: coralerius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "coralerius" is someone who works as a coral fisher (sometimes referred to as a coral farmer).

dcterms:title: magister teologie
dcterms:description: A person named as a "magister teologie" is a someone who studies and teaches theology.

dcterms:title: navigator
dcterms:description: A person named as a "navigator" is soemone who works at navigating or steering a ship.

dcterms:title: tinctor vermillii
dcterms:description: A person named as a "tinctor vermilii" is someone who works as a dyer with vermilion dye, made from cinnabar.

dcterms:title: cardinalis
dcterms:description: A person named as a "cardinalis" is someone who was appointed and works as a cardinal in the Roman Catholic Church.

dcterms:title: dux
dcterms:description: A person named as a "dux" is someone who serves as a doge or duke of a political territory, for example, the doge of Genoa.

dcterms:title: thesaurarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "thesaurarius" is someone who works as a treasurer, particularly for ecclesiastical institutions like churches or monasteries. The noun takes both masculine and feminine forms.

dcterms:title: selarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "selarius" is someone who works a saddler or saddle maker.

dcterms:title: prepositus
dcterms:description: A person named as a  "prepositus" is someone who works as a provost of an ecclesiastical institution.

dcterms:title: panesarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "panesarius" is someone who works as a baker, particuarly a baker of bread.

dcterms:title: ferrarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "ferrarius" is someone who works as a ironsmith.

dcterms:title: pictor
dcterms:description: A person named as a "pictor" is someone who works as a painter.

dcterms:title: candelerius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "candelarius" is someone who works as a candlemaker or chandler.

dcterms:title: lanternarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "lanternarius" is someone who manufactures and sells lanterns.

dcterms:title: cavallarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "cavallarius" is someone who served as a knight or a mounted soldier.

dcterms:title: sonator arpe
dcterms:description: A person named as a "sonator arpe" is someone who works as a harpist or a harp player.

dcterms:title: carzatorius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "carzatorius" or "carzator" is someone who works as a carder or wool-comber.

dcterms:title: conflator
dcterms:description: A person named as a "conflator" is someone who works with molten metals, often called a founder or caster.

dcterms:title: fravegus
dcterms:description: A person named as a "fravegus" is someone who works as a goldsmith.

dcterms:title: filator canapi
dcterms:description: A person named as a "filator canapi" is someone who works as a hemp spinner, generally spinning hemp thread for use in the manufacture of ropes and fishing nets.

dcterms:title: magister coralorum
dcterms:description: A person named as a "magister coralorum" is someone who works as a master of coral, that is, someone who produces items from coral (different from a coralerius, a coral fisher).
dcterms:alternative: magistro coralorum | magister corallorum | magister artis corallorum

dcterms:title: caldelarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "caldelarius" is someone who works as a cauldron-maker, or a maker of metal pots and kettles from copper, generally a specialized metal worker.

dcterms:title: molinarius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "molinarius" is someone who works as a miller.

dcterms:title: scriba galeate
dcterms:description: A person named as a "scriba galeate" is someone who works as a galley scribe.

dcterms:title: clavonerius
dcterms:description: A person named as a "clavonerius" is someone who works as a locksmith.

dcterms:title: rabbi
dcterms:description: A Jewish religious authority who works as a rabbi.

dcterms:title: rabarolius
dcterms:description: A person described as a rabarolius is grain warehouser or a grain merchant, or a general reseller of foodstuffs.

dcterms:title: cintracus
dcterms:description: A person named as a cintracus is someone who works as a municpal official, in Genoa this often referred to a crier, an official who makes public pronouncements.

dcterms:title: scriptor abrorum
dcterms:description: A person named as a scriptor abrorum is someone who works as a courier (in a managerial sense).

dcterms:title: tinctor endeghi
dcterms:description: A person named as a "tinctor endeghi" is someone who works as a dyer with indigo dye, made from the woad plant in the Genoese Mediterranean.

dcterms:title: magister ascie
dcterms:description: This occupational attribute describes a person who works as a shipwright,

dcterms:title: legator ballarum
dcterms:description: A person named as a "legator ballarum" is a master packer, a person who roped bales and was a fee-taker (most likely in a port).
dcterms:alternative: ligatore de balle | ligattor[e] ballarum | ligatori balarum

dcterms:title: magister arismetrice
dcterms:description: A person named as a magister arismetrice is someone who works as a teacher of arithmetic.
